title: When the Wolf Falls
author: Ansel Underhill
blurb: August Ravensworth, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
